Ooura FFT Package

The fast Fourier transform in WorldNet is a port of the FFT routines that WORLD
carries in src/fft.cpp. Those routines were written by Takuya Ooura and are
published at the following pages.

    http://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~ooura/index.html
    https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~ooura/fft.html

The author states the following terms for the package.

    Copyright Takuya OOURA, 1996-2001

    You may use, copy, modify and distribute this code for any purpose
    (include commercial use) and without fee. Please refer to this package
    when you modify this code.

WORLD records the origin of these routines in the header of src/fft.cpp.

    This file represents the functions about FFT (Fast Fourier Transform)
    implemented by Mr. Ooura, and wrapper functions implemented by M. Morise.

WORLD itself is distributed under the modified BSD license reproduced in
WORLD.txt in this directory.

Note: the modified BSD license referred to above is reproduced in the WORLD
section of this file.
